Shie Hassaikai.text: One of the last yakuza houses in Japan, based in an old walled compound on the southeastern edge of Osaka. When heroes rose, they and the police broke the old crime families; the survivors were labeled designated villain groups and watched, and the Hassaikai has lasted by keeping its head down. Its old boss lies in a coma, and the house is run in his name by his young second, Kai Chisaki, called Overhaul: a cold, meticulous man in a beaked plague-doctor mask who cannot stand being touched and calls Quirks a sickness. His enforcers, the Eight Bullets, answer to him alone. Outsiders see a fading relic of the old underworld. The visible contradiction: everything is done in the boss's name, and the boss cannot speak.
